why: The callout stages a user's manager-caller evidence with the credential's expiry, so
IssuedStore.resolve() refuses the generation after that expiry (SPEC 13.15) on every host path
that resolves it. Renewing an already-admitted run does not resolve the caller's generation, so
the run keeps renewing after it expires (SPEC 14.8). One mutation removes the recorded expiry,
the other makes renewal re-resolve the caller's generation; each must turn its own cell red.

mutations.name: the user-caller evidence is staged without the credential's expiry
mutations.expectRed: R54 expired generation must not authorize delayed first admission
mutations.cell: R54 expired generation must not authorize delayed first admission

mutations.name: run renewal re-resolves the admitted caller's generation
mutations.find: throw new EpEnvelopeError("conflict", "manager-service run renewal authority moved before issuance");
mutations.expectRed: R55 run admitted before its caller generation expired keeps renewing after expiry
mutations.cell: R55 run admitted before its caller generation expired keeps renewing after expiry
